title: Artifact
description: A durable external object (code, document, report, dataset, patch, plan) referenced from tasks, results, and memory rather than copied into them.

kind.description: e.g. file, report, patch, dataset, log

uri.description: Location within platform-managed durable storage. LocalSandbox accepts artifacts only from its per-execution output directory, copies verified regular files into separate artifact storage, then removes the execution root.

provenance.description: Where this content ultimately came from. Recorded from day one so later policy can act on taint (SECURITY_AND_PERMISSIONS: untrusted content).
